Sean Baker was so struck by Mikey Madison’s performance in Once Upon a Time in Hollywood that he revisited the film just to watch her scenes again. Then, after seeing Scream (2022), he walked out of the theater and immediately wanted her for Anora.

In this pivotal moment, Anora shifts from a wild, chaotic comedy into a heartbreaking tragedy, which changes everything for Ani played by "Mikey Madison". Sean Baker uses this plane sequence to trap the audience in the same claustrophobia Ani feels: the realization that wealth doesn't just buy things, it buys people. The film went on to become one of the biggest Oscar winners of the season, earning Best Picture, Best Director, Best Original Screenplay, Best Editing, and Best Actress at the 2025 Academy Awards cementing its place as a modern classic and a landmark for indie filmmaking.
